subject: Renewal: staged procurement gate + PO consolidation plan
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
To: Asha Rao <procurement@nimbushealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-25 09:12 -0700
Subject: Renewal: staged procurement gate + PO consolidation plan

Hi Asha,

Thanks again for the renewal signal this week — appreciate the fast turnaround from your team. Per our conversation, we'd like to propose a two-stage procurement approach to keep NimbusHealth running on current committed capacity during contract signature and then consolidate the PO for the Q3 capacity uplift.

High-level proposal:
- Stage 1: Short-term extension (30 days) under existing SOW to avoid a service gap; procurement signs a short PO for the current monthly commit.
- Stage 2: Consolidated PO & capacity uplift: once legal finalizes the term amendment, ProcureCo will accept a single PO reflecting the new committed capacity and updated term.

Operational asks from Nimbus:
1) Can procurement accept a temporary PO for current spend while legal finalizes the amendment?
2) Who will be the ProcureCo contact for the consolidated PO routing and invoicing?
3) Any evidence or vendor attestation items your gate requires this week? we can upload to the portal.

I've attached a draft PO template and the evidence bundle we typically submit for renewals to accelerate the portal intake. Marissa — looping you to confirm the billing contact and whether we can use the short-term extension language in the SOW addendum.

Best,
Jonas
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

Attachments: nimbus_po_template.pdf, redwood_evidence_bundle.zip

From: Asha Rao <procurement@nimbushealth.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Cc: ProcureCo Ops <procureops@procureco.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-25 11:03 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal: staged procurement gate + PO consolidation plan

Jonas — thanks for the clear summary. A few quick notes from procurement at Nimbus: 

- Short-term PO: acceptable as long as the term extension language references the forthcoming master amendment (we'll need the amendment reference number once it's available).
- Evidence: we need a current SOC2 attestation and the vendor PCI/environmental checklist updated in ProcureCo by COB Friday. The redwood_evidence_bundle looks good, but ProcureCo asks for the doc ID in their portal.
- ProcureCo contact: hi ProcureCo team — can you confirm the routing rules for consolidating two PO lines into one final invoice?

If ProcureCo confirms the routing, we can issue the short PO today and follow up with the consolidated PO in 14–21 days.

Regards,
Asha
Sr. Procurement Manager
NimbusHealth

Date: 2027-04-26 08:47 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal: staged procurement gate + PO consolidation plan

Hi Asha — thanks for the quick reply. A few operational clarifications from our side: 

- SOC2: attached is the link to the latest attestation and the evidence bundle includes the portal doc IDs (procure link in my signature). We'll also push the zipped evidence to ProcureCo today.
- Short-term extension language: approved — we will issue an addendum with the following bullet: 
  • "Short-term 30-day extension to current SOW pending execution of Master Amendment #RW-2024-0987-AM1."
- Billing contact for consolidated PO & invoicing: Karthik will be the point of contact for final PO consolidation and invoice routing (karthik_iyer@redwood.com).

Next steps I propose:
1) ProcureCo confirms portal doc ID acceptance and PO-routing rules (Asha / ProcureCo).
2) Nimbus issues short PO for current monthly commit (Asha).
3) Redwood issues SOW addendum and uploads evidence to ProcureCo (Marissa).
4) Once legal signs amendment, ProcureCo/ Nimbus and Redwood coordinate for consolidated PO and final invoice.

Karthik — please confirm you have capacity to manage invoicing coordination once we hit the consolidation stage.

Thanks,
Marissa
Head of Renewals
Redwood Inference
Procurement Portal: https://procureco.example.com/tenant/nimbushealth/docs

Attachments: pricing-statement-202704.pdf

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Asha Rao <procurement@nimbushealth.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-27 15:03 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal: staged procurement gate + PO consolidation plan

Asha / team — Karthik here. I can own the invoice consolidation and AP handoff. A couple logistics: 

- When you issue the short PO, please include a reference field: "Pending Master Amendment RW-2024-0987-AM1" so AR teams can correlate invoices.
- For the consolidated PO step, we'll need the final amendment signed and the final committed capacity numbers in the PO line item. If Nimbus prefers, we can accept a two-line PO (current month + uplift) and net at invoice time, but the single consolidated PO is cleaner for our AR.
- We'll confirm acceptance of ProcureCo's routing once they reply here.

I'll stand by for the short PO and will start the invoice template to reduce cycle time.

Thanks — Karthik
Commercial Operations
Redwood Inference
